findings.title: Harvests on the To date are left out of the stats (range end is exclusive)
findings.where: /stats and GET /api/stats/harvests (also dashboard top plant via top_plants)
findings.expected: From=To=2026-09-30 includes the 150 g Lettuce harvest logged that day (1 harvest, 150 g); the queries use harvested_on < to
findings.actual: API returns harvest_count 0, total_grams 0; page shows '0 harvests from 30 Sept 2026 to 30 Sept 2026' and 'No harvests in this range'

findings.title: Malformed stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats…' over stale data
findings.expected: An error message, and no stale table for the previous range
findings.actual: Uncaught 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')', 'Loading stats…' stays on screen, and the previous range's table (1 Jan to 31 Dec) is still shown for the new From date
